page_title: LIV 0-0 MNU | Liverpool v Manchester Utd 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+4' Yet another yellow card and Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is sent off for talking out of turn to the referee. Definitely a harebrained moment from the player. Michael Oliver doesn't allow any discussions.
90+4' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.

90+3' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went a whisker over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
90+2' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Oliver had an easy-decision to make.

90+1' Hannibal Mejbri (Manchester United) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Liverpool are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) has tested the patience of referee Michael Oliver and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

86' Golden chance! Joe Gomez (Liverpool) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
85' That looked a certain handball by Luke Shaw (Manchester United) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
85' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

84' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Good work from Liverpool as they win a corner.
82' Erik ten Hag has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Facundo Pellistri (Manchester United) replacing Antony.
82' The game has come to an end for Kobbie Mainoo. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Hannibal Mejbri (Manchester United).
82' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

81' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Andre Onana was ready and made a save.
80' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
79' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
79' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Here is a change. Darwin Nunez is going off and Jurgen Klopp gives the last tactical orders to Harvey Elliott (Liverpool).
78' It's time for a substitution. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) comes on in place of Luis Diaz.
78' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Andre Onana.
77' Liverpool failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

76' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) attempts to turn the rebound in from close range. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save and stops the ball from hitting the net. Great goalkeeping. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
71' A substitution has been made. Alejandro Garnacho goes off and Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) comes on.

70' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
70' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box to the left side of the goal, but Andre Onana shows his agility and makes a save.
70' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
68' Alisson pulls off a great save to deny Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.

67' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.

66' Mohamed Salah sprays a wonderful pass out to Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Andre Onana problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.

64' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the top left corner. Andre Onana pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
62' It will be a substitution. Joe Gomez (Liverpool) is ready to enter the pitch as Dominik Szoboszlai walks off.
61' Ryan Gravenberch is being substituted because of an injury. Jurgen Klopp sends Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) on the pitch.
60' It doesn’t look good for Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
59' PENALTY APPEAL after Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
58' Flag goes up against Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
57' Liverpool keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
52' Total attempts – 18:2.

48' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) starts an individual run, not looking to pass to a teammate, and easily weaves through the defence to get deep inside the box. He shoots low, but misses the goal by a whisker! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
47' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
47' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
42' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Andre Onana is equal to it and makes an easy save.

37' Konstantinos Tsimikas floats a good corner into the box that Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) gets on the end of, but his effort on goal scorches just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
37' Corner kick. Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) is ready to send the ball into the box.

36' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
35' What was Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
33' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is penalised for a foul. Michael Oliver had a clear view and blows his whistle.
31' The game is interrupted as Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is flagged offside.

29' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
29' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) prepares to take a corner kick.

29' What a great chance for Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Liverpool.
29' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is about to take a corner kick.
28' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
27' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
21' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
19' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
19' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
18' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee blows his whistle, Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
17' That's unlucky! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
17' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
16' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Liverpool force their opponents to concede a corner.
16' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner but it's cleared.

16' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) shoots the rebound towards the goal. His effort lacks pace and that allows the goalkeeper to pull off a stunning save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Liverpool.

16' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.

16' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.

11' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.

11' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) controls a great pass from Scott McTominay on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
7' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) is adjudged offside.
7' Antony (Manchester United) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
5' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
5' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
5' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
2' The free kick from Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) is cleared away from danger by one of the defenders.
2' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Liverpool are awarded the free kick.
1' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
1' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Liverpool will have a corner.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Liverpool will take the kick-off.
Michael Oliver will supervise the game today.
